Bash(source .venv/bin/activate && python3 << 'EOF'
from database import SessionLocal
from models import Student, BulletinLine

db = SessionLocal\(\)
s = db.query\(Student\).filter\(Student.first_name.like\('%alom%'\)\).first\(\)

# Voir ce qu'on a dans la ligne BILAN pour les deux trimestres
bilans = db.query\(BulletinLine\).filter\(
    BulletinLine.student_id == s.id,
    BulletinLine.subject == "BILAN"
\).all\(\)
for b in bilans:
    print\(f"T{b.trimestre} | avg={b.average} | absences={b.absences} | retards={b.tardiness}"\)
    print\(f"  appreciation = {repr\(b.appreciation\)}"\)
    print\(f"  contenu      = {repr\(b.contenu\)}"\)
db.close\(\)
EOF)
